chapter: Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan years
title: Opening of the session at Tulane, October 13, 1961
summary: Dick Allen announces the recording location and date and picks up the earlier talk about the pianist Buddy Christian.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Let's see, we're recording today in Seminar Room 2 of the Howard Tilton Memorial Library, Tulane University. What's today's date anyway? Friday the 13th. October the 13th, 1961. Let's get your name down there. Mary Alfred Williams. Elizabeth Snail. Yeah, I'm Dick Allen. And we were talking about that piano player that suddenly came to you. Yeah, Buddy Christian. And where did he play? He played Pete Lallis with King Oliver, Old Man Balto.
